description: This file defines a command handler class responsible for processing delete requests for credit reports within the Fineract credit bureau module. It primarily handles deletion commands and delegates the actual delete operation to a platform service.

classes.name: DeleteCreditReportCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles the deletion of credit reports based on commands received. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface and uses CreditReportWritePlatformService to perform the deletion.

methods.name: DeleteCreditReportCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the CreditReportWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the delete command for a credit report and delegates the deletion to the write platform service, returning the result.
